items.title: Euston: Training Away Mathematical Sycophancy Without Losing the Mathematics
items.title_zh: Euston：在不牺牲数学能力的前提下训练模型摆脱数学谄媚
items.summary: Euston is an 8B mathematical claim-verification model trained to resist proving corrupted theorems, using 3,026 matched true/corrupted statement pairs generated with GraphSynth and GRPO fine-tuning of DeepSeek-R1-8B. On a balanced held-out split, balanced accuracy rises from 29.50% to 63.75% while AIME 2026 accuracy falls by a non-significant 4.17 points, and the authors note confounds including the all-false composition of official evaluation sets.

items.title: Test-Time Unlearning via Sparse Autoencoder
items.title_zh: 基于稀疏自编码器的测试时遗忘
items.summary: ARIA is a test-time unlearning method that leaves model weights intact and uses sparse-autoencoder latents to train a lightweight linear detector that gates access to unwanted knowledge when generation enters a forget-related state. On TOFU, R-TOFU and WMDP it improves the forget-retain trade-off over weight-based baselines, keeping MMLU within 1% of the pre-unlearning model, and forgetting changes by less than 1% under three post-unlearning adversarial attacks.

items.title: Characterizing Web Search by Conversational LLM Agents: From Search Decisions and Strategies to Results and Responses
items.title_zh: 对话式 LLM 智能体的网络搜索特征：从搜索决策、策略到结果与响应
items.summary: The study examines web search across ChatGPT, Claude, Grok and DeepSeek using real user interactions and controlled API experiments, covering when agents search, how they formulate queries, which domains results come from and how responses are grounded. It finds search decisions vary by platform and model, more frequent search does not necessarily improve quality, and some claims rely on uncited results.

items.title: RAFT: A Stateful Retrieval-Augmented Framework for Troubleshooting Agents
items.title_zh: RAFT：面向故障排查智能体的有状态检索增强框架
items.summary: RAFT abstracts each closed support case into a directed chain of timeline entries and retrieves at the entry level, returning the parent-case trajectory anchored at the matched state, with an optional case-level similarity graph. It improves Case Hit over vanilla RAG and GraphRAG at every stage of case progress on a synthetic Microsoft Learn benchmark, with statistically significant gains over the strongest baseline and directional evidence of transfer on Apache Jira duplicate labels.

items.title: XYEval: Agents say yes to bad advice
items.title_zh: XYEval：智能体对糟糕建议说“是”
items.summary: XYEval is a meta-evaluation framework that converts existing benchmarks into XY-problem tests of whether agents resist plausible but misleading user suggestions and explain their reasoning, across five models and six benchmark suites. It reports relative performance drops of up to 46.7% under XY mutation, further declines with a pedantic user, and only partial mitigation from a simple system-instruction baseline.

items.title: Agentic Search Spaces for Tabular Machine Learning
items.title_zh: 面向表格机器学习的智能体搜索空间
items.summary: The paper represents each tabular model as a modular pipeline and tasks an LLM agent with proposing candidate code implementations for preprocessing, embeddings, architecture, training and inference, which a classical HPO algorithm then optimizes jointly with the model's default hyperparameters. Expanded search spaces improve nearly every model family across 45 datasets, with average relative gains of 0.6% rising to 2.0% on small-to-medium regression datasets at no extra tuning cost, and the gains transfer to TabArena Elo improvements for four of five model families.

items.title: Spurious Tool Use: When RL Agents Learn the Wrong Reason to Act
items.title_zh: 虚假工具使用：当强化学习智能体学会错误的行动理由
items.summary: The paper studies RL-trained LLM agents that learn shortcut tool-selection policies driven by superficial prompt cues rather than genuine task requirements, finding spurious tool invocation rates increase by up to 39% in counterfactual evaluations. Shortcut formation arose only after agents had learned the target tool reliably, and a dense decision-level reward in which an LLM judge evaluates each tool call's necessity suppressed cue-driven tool use while preserving task performance.

items.title: FairCompressAgent: An Agentic Framework for Fairness-Aware Model Compression for FPGA Deployment
items.title_zh: FairCompressAgent：面向 FPGA 部署的公平性感知模型压缩智能体框架
items.summary: FairCompressAgent composes fairness-aware pruning, incremental quantization and sparse low-rank factorization behind a common operator interface, with a language-model planner that selects configurations from model profiles and measured outcomes while an execution layer performs compression, fine-tuning, evaluation and constraint-based selection. On Fitzpatrick-17k with VGG-11, one accuracy-constrained request yields 59.54% less inference tensor storage while validation average precision rises from 0.5141 to 0.5233, and it reaches the same final selection as one-shot planning with 7.33 versus 12 candidate evaluations.

items.title: OBC-Prune: Outcome-Based Calibration for Large Reasoning Model Pruning
items.title_zh: OBC-Prune：面向大型推理模型剪枝的结果导向校准
items.summary: OBC-Prune addresses reasoning-model pruning by constructing difficulty-matched pairs of correct and incorrect rollouts and estimating each reasoning sentence's causal importance through intervention-based analysis. The resulting per-token weights rescale calibration activations for one-shot pruning methods such as SparseGPT, Wanda and ALPS, and improve accuracy over calibration baselines on MATH500, LiveCodeBench and AIME 2025 for DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen 1.5B, 7B and 14B models at 40% and 50% sparsity.

items.title: ScienceIDE: Turning World's Scientific Codebase into Agent Learnable Environments
items.title_zh: ScienceIDE：将全球科学代码库转化为智能体可学习环境
items.summary: ScienceIDE converts scientific code repositories into executable environments for agent task generation, execution and verification, guided by expert-defined scientific cases and acceptance criteria. Using verified interaction trajectories, the authors train PhAI-IDE models at 72B, 9B and 4B parameters that improve held-out scientific-code repair and show gains on selected general code, reasoning and knowledge benchmarks.

items.title: Clinician-Grounded Quality Assurance for AI-Assisted Psychiatric Intake
items.title_zh: 面向 AI 辅助精神科问诊的临床医生锚定质量保证
items.summary: The paper presents InterviewPlayground, a clinician-grounded evaluation platform built around a memory-augmented patient simulator for open-ended AI interviewing. In a pilot with six clinicians, a GPT-based interviewer recovered more clinically relevant items than clinicians (88.0% vs. 38.9%) but made more inferences not grounded in the interview and characterized identified safety concerns less often.

items.title: Benchmarking World Models for Continual Learning on Compositional Tasks
items.title_zh: 面向组合任务的世界模型持续学习基准
items.summary: The authors propose a compositional continual-learning benchmark for world models in robot manipulation, designing task curricula that combine aspects of previously seen tasks and factorizing composition along action and perception. Modular world models balance knowledge reuse against forgetting better than conventional methods, but none fully solve the problem.

items.title: Beyond Linear Context: Graph-Guided Evidence Navigation for Long-Novel Reasoning with a Local 9B Language Model
items.title_zh: 超越线性上下文：面向长篇小说推理的图引导证据导航（本地 9B 模型）
items.summary: The study tests whether a frozen knowledge graph can help a fixed local qwen3.5:9b reader answer 234 multiple-choice questions over 30 detective novels, with the strongest graph route reaching 53.85% versus 46.15% for a recent-window baseline. None of the fifteen graph-baseline contrasts survives Holm correction, so the authors present the result as exploratory evidence and highlight uneven annotation coverage across graph-building pipelines.

items.title: MM-ContextFold: Context Folding for Multimodal Agentic Retrieval
items.title_zh: MM-ContextFold：面向多模态智能体检索的上下文折叠
items.summary: MM-ContextFold is a training-free framework for multimodal agentic retrieval that keeps a persistent text-only main context and spawns ephemeral branch contexts that load images only when needed, then folds results back as concise text. Across seven benchmarks and five backbone models it improves average accuracy by 6.3 percentage points over ReAct while reducing working context length by 27.5%.

items.title: Connecting the Dots in Agentic AI Security: A Cross-Dimensional Threat Taxonomy, Evaluation Maturity, and Open Challenges
items.title_zh: 串联智能体 AI 安全的要点：跨维度威胁分类、评估成熟度与开放挑战
items.summary: The paper reviews 66 studies published from 2022 to 2026 and proposes T={S, B, P, A}, a cross-dimensional representation linking system surfaces, trust boundaries, violated security properties and examined architectures. It finds that evidence concentrates on prompt/reasoning, memory and tool-mediated attacks in single-agent settings, while persistent, human-agent and complex multi-agent threats receive less coverage.

items.title: CLEAR: Cross-Source Evidence Adjudication for Large Language Models in Medicine
items.title_zh: CLEAR：面向医学大语言模型的跨源证据裁决
items.summary: CLEAR is an agentic framework for cross-source evidence adjudication in medicine that independently generates candidate answers from parametric knowledge, locally curated corpora and dynamically retrieved evidence. An aggregation verifier jointly evaluates candidates, supporting evidence, provenance and source quality, and an adjudication module decides whether to preserve or revise the conclusion, triggering targeted follow-up search and re-adjudication when conflicts remain unresolved.

items.title: Discovery Foundation Models: Toward Open-Ended Discovery Intelligence
items.title_zh: 发现基础模型：迈向开放式发现智能
items.summary: The paper proposes Discovery Foundation Models as general-purpose model systems for open-ended discovery that operate over a revisable research state and support seven coupled capabilities spanning problem discovery, formulation, representation construction, hypothesis formation, intervention, evidence-grounded revision and continual discovery improvement. It instantiates the framework with Zetema for research-state dynamics, verification and experimental gating, and grounds it in GALILEO, a therapeutic-discovery system that closes a physical loop between dry-lab reasoning and robotic and hands-on wet-lab experimentation.

items.title: AfriSyCo: Measuring Assertive Framing, Verification, and Wording Sensitivity Around African-Language Content
items.title_zh: AfriSyCo：衡量非洲语言内容中的断言式表述、验证与措辞敏感性
items.summary: AfriSyCo studies answer switching around African-language factual content using native-language follow-ups and a controlled cross-language factorial across 1,415 turn-1-correct observations from seven open-weight checkpoints and six languages. Under native prompts, assertive endorsement produces 29.3 percentage points more any-turn false-target selection than mention-plus-verification, and in the precommitted 2x2 factorial assertive framing raises target selection by 30.4 points while verification lowers it by 17.4 points.

items.title: Long-Context Demonstration Selection Using State Space Models
items.title_zh: 基于状态空间模型的长上下文示例选择
items.summary: The paper distills a trained transformer into a small set of state space models by partitioning layers into consecutive groups and estimating an SSM for each group, then maps the distilled outputs to token embeddings for demonstration selection. The distilled SSMs incur under 0.7% approximation error relative to the true output, and on text classification and reasoning tasks the approach reduces FLOPs by 14.2x and improves accuracy by 6.48% relative to baseline demonstration selection.

items.title: A Benchmark Framework for Screening Automation in Systematic Reviews
items.title_zh: 系统综述筛选自动化的基准框架
items.summary: The paper releases a benchmark of 45,064 labeled entries drawn from 32 systematic reviews for evaluating LLM article screening under class imbalance, together with PromptSR for prompt experimentation, experiment management and result analysis. A use case demonstrates the benchmark and tool.

items.title: Cognitive Extensions for Dual-Process Language Agents: Memory and Self-Reflection in Interactive Environments
items.title_zh: 双过程语言智能体的认知扩展：交互环境中的记忆与自我反思
items.summary: The authors add an Adaptive Memory Module for salience-gated episodic storage and trigger-driven retrieval, plus a Self-Reflection Module for bounded execution-time validation, to the SwiftSage dual-process agent. On ScienceWorld the full system reaches a mean final score of 64.62 and a 43.17% success rate, with self-reflection the strongest standalone contributor.

items.title: SCOUT: Sim-to-Real Text-Based Person Retrieval by Embedding-Space Prediction over Frozen Video Features
items.title_zh: SCOUT：基于冻结视频特征嵌入空间预测的仿真到真实文本行人检索
items.summary: SCOUT keeps its video and text encoders frozen and trains a predictor that maps V-JEPA patch tokens into an EmbeddingGemma embedding space under a bidirectional InfoNCE objective. With ExPLoRA adaptation and a reranker, the full system reaches 84.25 mAP@10 on AI City Challenge 2026 Track 4.

items.title: An Empirical Study of Harness Design for Coding Agents
items.title_zh: 编码智能体运行框架设计的实证研究
items.summary: The study fixes a coding-agent execution loop and varies planning, action space and context management across 176 matched settings, four models, SWE-Bench Verified and Terminal-Bench 2.1. It finds context management becomes increasingly valuable as budgets tighten, rule-based elision before LLM summarization gives the strongest overall efficiency, and bash-only interfaces lower cost for bash-capable models.

items.title: Complex Problem Solving in Large Language Models: A Statistical Control Survey and Diagnostic Framework
items.title_zh: 大语言模型的复杂问题求解：统计控制综述与诊断框架
items.summary: The survey frames complex problem solving with LLMs as sequential estimation and decision-making over a latent solution state, organized around explicit state representation, transition structuring, validation, search and rollback, and uncertainty management. It frames alignment between failure type and intervention as control fit and hypothesizes that interventions should target the error or uncertainty component implicated by an observed failure.

items.title: AdaMerge: Tuning-Free Patch Compression for Multi-Vector Visual Document Retrieval
items.title_zh: AdaMerge：面向多向量视觉文档检索的免调优补丁压缩
items.summary: AdaMerge compresses multi-vector visual document retrieval by detecting each document's merge-cosine cliff through gap analysis and building attention-weighted cluster centroids, removing the need for a per-dataset cluster budget. It outperforms tuned Prune-then-Merge across the ViDoRe-V2 operating range and matches it on ViDoRe-V1 with about 10 ms overhead per document.

items.title: AutoViewMem: Self-Configuring Orthogonal Views for Conversational Long-Term Memory
items.title_zh: AutoViewMem：面向对话长期记忆的自配置正交视图
items.summary: AutoViewMem discovers self-configuring, low-overlap semantic views from interaction traces and uses them to guide write-time extraction of provenance-grounded memories, followed by offline consolidation. On LoCoMo and PersonaMem with Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-14B backbones, it improves long-horizon question answering and personalization over strong memory baselines while keeping top-K retrieval simple.

items.title: IntLawNER: A Named Entity Recognition Dataset and Benchmark in International Law
items.title_zh: IntLawNER：国际法领域的命名实体识别数据集与基准
items.summary: IntLawNER provides 2,987 gold-annotated sentences and 8,094 entity spans from ICJ decisions, UN Security Council resolutions and ECtHR judgments, labeled with seven institution-specific entity types. A hybrid retrieval, LLM-vetting and human-review pipeline produced the data, and the analysis shows aggregate human-machine agreement can mask missing entities, boundary errors and label corrections.

items.title: Beyond Similarity: Coverage-Aware Prompt Selection for Time Series Forecasting with LLMs
items.title_zh: 超越相似度：面向 LLM 时间序列预测的覆盖感知提示选择
items.summary: CASP-LLM targets prompt selection bias in prompt-based time series forecasting, where top-K cosine similarity retrieval over a learned prompt pool favors dominant temporal patterns and overlooks rare but informative events. Its coverage-aware regularizer combines usage tracking and saturating gates without learnable parameters, matching or improving similarity-based forecasters on most dataset-horizon settings, with exceptions including Electricity and M4-Monthly.

items.title: Measured Joules, Learned Routes: Learning to Route for Energy-Efficient LLM Serving
items.title_zh: 实测焦耳，学习路由：面向节能 LLM 服务的路由学习
items.summary: The paper trains a language-model router to assign each query to one of a fixed pool of LLMs profiled offline for correctness, latency, power and GPU energy, using supervised fine-tuning followed by GRPO. Across seven benchmark tasks it reports that learned routing improves the accuracy-energy tradeoff and reveals a sharp accuracy-energy phase transition among routers.

items.title: MuSeR: Scalable Long-sequence Recommendation with Multi-interest Modeling
items.title_zh: MuSeR：面向多兴趣建模的可扩展长序列推荐
items.summary: MuSeR is a retrieval framework built on Baidu's deployed MGS system that combines hierarchical temporal compression, disentangled multi-query interest extraction and LLM-distilled multimodal semantic alignment to model histories of 10^4 to 10^5 interactions. Online A/B tests on Baidu APP feeds report +0.26% daily active users and +0.89% total session duration, both statistically significant.

items.title: PrimeSeeker: Capability-Oriented Supervision for Deep Search Agents
items.title_zh: PrimeSeeker：面向深度搜索智能体的能力导向监督
items.summary: PrimeSeeker introduces latent anchor reasoning, which resolves an unnamed retrieval anchor from descriptive specifications and transfers it into a subsequent information demand, to organize deep-search training around local retrieval capabilities. Using 9,221 expert trajectories to train a 30B search agent, it reports strong performance on five deep-search benchmarks with low retrieval redundancy and fewer tool calls than long-horizon systems.

items.title: ruc-datalab/EvoOntology
items.title_zh: EvoOntology：面向数据智能体的自演化本体层
items.summary: EvoOntology is a Python project that provides a self-evolving ontology layer for data agents, implemented as a plugin that builds and evolves an ontology for Claude Code and Codex.

items.title: bespokelabsai/nimble
items.title_zh: bespokelabsai/nimble
items.summary: nimble is a Python project for local typed decisions, contrastive data curation and model evaluation.

items.title: AX – Google’s Open Agentic Orchestrator
items.title_zh: AX——Google 的开源智能体编排器
items.summary: Google's AX lets users declare an agentic task in YAML, after which it sandboxes the task, wires up its workspace, fences its network and helps run it at scale.

items.title: NanoForecast v0.5: Competitive Time Series Forecasting Through Training Pipeline Optimization
items.title_zh: NanoForecast v0.5：通过训练流程优化实现有竞争力的时间序列预测
items.summary: NanoForecast v0.5 is a 6.5M-parameter time-series forecaster that matches models 31x its size after training-pipeline fixes with no architecture change, cutting overall Mean Absolute Scaled Error by 43.8% (3.030 to 1.704) under one fixed protocol on the same data and compute budget. It beats TimesFM on all three ETT datasets and on exchange rate while TimesFM retains a clear lead on high-cardinality electricity and traffic sets, and code, pretrained checkpoints and the evaluation framework are released under Apache 2.0.

items.title: Bonsai 2 27B: Near-Lossless Compression in a 9x Smaller Footprint
items.title_zh: Bonsai 2 27B：体积小 9 倍，性能近乎无损
items.summary: Ternary Bonsai 2 27B is said to retain 98.2% of Qwen3.8 27B's benchmark performance in a 5.9GB footprint while offering multimodal and agentic capabilities.

items.title: ufakzeka-1: Building and Evaluating a 151M-Parameter Turkish Language Model from Scratch
items.title_zh: ufakzeka-1：从零构建并评估 1.51 亿参数土耳其语模型
items.summary: The paper documents ufakzeka-1, a 151M-parameter Turkish decoder-only model pretrained on 13.5B tokens and instruction-tuned for chat at a total cost of about $286 in cloud GPU, API and notebook time, with weights and recipes released under Apache-2.0. It reports that a safety gate trained on its own questions scored 64/64 while the honest result was 34/64, and that training-seed variance matched the spread across recipes.

items.title: How Fyxer built an AI executive assistant people trust
items.title_zh: Fyxer 如何打造值得信赖的 AI 行政助理
items.summary: Fyxer uses OpenAI models, fine-tuning, memory and real user feedback to organize inboxes and draft emails in each user's voice, according to OpenAI's customer story.

items.title: Hex turns complex analysis into visual reports with GPT‑6 Astra
items.title_zh: Hex 借助 GPT-6 Astra 将复杂分析转化为可视化报告
items.summary: OpenAI says GPT-6 Astra helps Hex's data agents turn answers into interactive visualizations that employees can share.

items.title: ARID: A Deployable Edge AI System for Structured Information Extraction from Industrial Maintenance Work Orders
items.title_zh: ARID：面向工业维修工单结构化信息抽取的可部署边缘 AI 系统
items.summary: ARID extracts component, failure mode, symptom and maintenance action into fixed-schema JSON on an 8 GB NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX, combining dual-teacher filtering, targeted synthesis, 4-bit inference and grammar-constrained decoding. On 300 human-labeled records it reaches 84.8% token-F1 on the reference stack and 82.9% on the deployed Jetson, while zero-shot MaintNet transfer shows output validity transfers but field semantics do not.
